question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

We, as human beings, have a tendency of believing in the __things that can be seen and touched__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"impalpable"** means something that cannot be felt by touch; intangible. (अस्पृश्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The impalpable aura of mystery surrounding the old house intrigued the children.
 
 
 
• **"Spiritual" **refers to something related to the spirit or soul, often in a religious context, and not physical or material. (आध्यात्मिक)
 
 
• **Example: **She finds peace through her spiritual practices like meditation and prayer.
 
 
 
• **"Inexpressible" **means something that is too strong to be described or conveyed in words. (अवर्णनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The beauty of the sunset was inexpressible and left everyone in awe.
 
 
 
• **"Tangible" **refers to something that can be touched or is physically real; perceptible by touch. (स्पर्शनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The tangible benefits of the new policy were immediately felt by the employees.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Impala** (अफ्रीकी हिरन ): A medium-sized antelope found in eastern and southern Africa.
 
 
• **Example:** The impala gracefully leaped across the savannah, evading its predators.
 
 
 
• **Spiritual **(आध्यात्मिक): Relating to or affecting the human spirit or soul as opposed to material or physical things.
 
 
• **Example: **Many people seek spiritual enlightenment through meditation and prayer.
 
 
 
• **Inexpressible** (अवर्णनीय): Too strong to be described or conveyed in words.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist’s joy at winning the award was inexpressible.
